entries.prompt: Create a precise GAME SPRITE PARTS SHEET for the supplied level-one wooden crossbow tower. Preserve the exact high-definition softly sculpted 3D-prerender style, warm upper-left lighting, honey timber grain, rounded stone feet, tiny moss and the exact structure and camera of the reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Lay out 3 separate nonoverlapping parts in a wide horizontal sheet, generous spacing, no labels or grid. LEFT: the complete static tower body from ground plinth to rear/side railings, EXACT original base and proportions, REMOVE the crossbow and its arrow completely; retain the small pivot mounting block on the platform. For correct layering REMOVE ONLY the nearest/front V-shaped horizontal railing and nearest corner post from this body; leave the other rear/side rails. MIDDLE: exactly that removed front V-shaped horizontal railing with its nearest corner post, shown at the same camera and scale as in the left body, floating isolated on transparent. RIGHT: the full original crossbow assembly with bow stave, taut bow string, wooden stock, silver-tipped bolt and rotation mounting pin, isolated on transparent, same camera and scale as original. All three parts should reassemble into the reference without design changes. No shadow cast on an invisible ground; preserve self-shadow/AO within each component. Opaque wood/stone/metal, clean antialiased edges without glow. Do not create a different tower, no new ornaments, no text, no multiple frames. This is an editable sprite decomposition sheet for a native 2D game animation.
entries.mattePrompt: Correct the transparency matte of this sprite parts sheet ONLY. Keep all three depicted wooden crossbow-tower components exactly unchanged in shape, proportions, camera and detailing. Completely remove ALL of the soft colored haze, blurred brown/green glow, ambient background, floor shadows and reflections OUTSIDE the solid component silhouettes, including the spaces between wooden beams. Those surrounding/background pixels MUST be fully transparent alpha=0. Every solid wooden beam, rope, metal bolt, stone and tiny plant within a component must be fully opaque alpha=255 except for a 1-pixel antialiased edge. No semi-transparent entire object, no soft matte or transparent holes inside solid materials. Preserve the isolated moss/soil plinth as an opaque part of the left tower base, not a blur. Preserve the isolated front rail center part and crossbow right part. Do not add or redesign anything. Clean cutout sprites suitable for layering over colored grass.

entries.prompt: Decompose this exact stone slingshot tower into THREE high-definition 2D game sprites on a wide transparent sheet. Preserve reference style, camera, proportions, warm upper-left light, softly sculpted pale stone and honey wood. LEFT: complete low stone tower static body with original round parapet and arch doorway, including the two fixed wooden slingshot uprights, but REMOVE all flexible rope strands, leather pouch and loaded stone; wood upright tips and bindings stay. MIDDLE: only the V-shaped pair of elastic bands and leather pouch with grey round stone loaded, exactly reference shape and camera, as one floating isolated sprite. RIGHT: same V-shaped elastic bands and empty leather pouch, in a released taut raised pose, with no stone. Parts will be layered to animate loading and firing; fixed wooden uprights do not move. Leave generous space between sprites. No labels, no scenery or ground plane. Background must be fully transparent, no haze, no blur or surrounding glow. Opaque component surfaces, clean antialiased silhouette, self-shading preserved. No changes in design, no extra weapons.

Decompose this exact cyan-crystal wooden pavilion tower into TWO high-definition 2D game sprites on a transparent wide sheet. LEFT: complete original static tower base, stone feet, wooden rounded walls, cream hanging banners, exact golden curved roof and circular gold socket on top, but remove ONLY the large cyan ice crystal sitting in that socket, leaving the empty socket interior visible. Keep the small cyan ornament on front wall. RIGHT: just the removed large cyan crystal, whole pointed crystal with exact facet shape, camera, blue-cyan colors, material highlights and bottom facet, isolated at matching scale. Preserve original structure and softly sculpted 3D-prerender quality with upper-left warm key light and gentle cool crystal reflections. No ground cast shadow, no particles or glowing haze outside silhouette, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid. Clean alpha-zero background, solid opaque wood and stone, crisp solid crystal with bright internal facets rather than transparent invisible glass. Generous separation so sprites can be cropped independently.

Create a high-definition seamlessly tileable stylized game DIRT ROAD MATERIAL, flat top-down orthographic square texture only. Match the warm soft sculpted 3D-prerender Chinese chibi village reference: pale honey-beige packed earth, gently varying broad soft patches, extremely fine restrained grain, a few tiny rounded sandy particles but NO separate stones, NO ruts, NO hard edges or cracks, NO grass, NO trees, NO objects, NO border, NO lettering, NO gradient from top to bottom, uniform diffuse illumination. This is a quiet ground surface under small characters, low contrast, neither photographic gritty sand nor flat vector. Seamless left-right and top-bottom edges, diffuse albedo with soft painterly volume at tiny scale. Warm beige around #dcc18e, avoid bright yellow or orange. 1024x1024 square opaque texture.
